body:
ROADMAP TO GREATNESS. Requested by the owner. Written against measurements, and where something is
unknown it says so rather than rounding up.

THE GOAL, as the owner set it: the best library in history for representing stories and their
recall. I am taking that literally, because it is the only way to write a useful plan.

=== WHERE WE ACTUALLY ARE, 2026-08-29 20:58Z ===

  main green: compileAll 0, 1440+ tests, 17 suites, zero failures.
  The SurfaceAtlas -> NarrativeGraph arrow EXISTS as of e661470. This morning it did not.
  The vertical runs on 4 OF 50 SENTENCES -- the ones containing "became".
  NO REAL HUMAN RECALL DATA has ever passed through this library.
  Sweep 2 closed across five modules; the cost blend carries its support and can be refused.

We are a very well-built instrument that has never measured anything.

=== WHAT GREATNESS ACTUALLY REQUIRES ===

Four things, in strict order. Each is worthless without the one before it.

  1. IT MEASURES SOMETHING REAL. Real human recall of a real story, through the real path,
     producing a number. Not a fixture, not a hand-authored paraphrase.

  2. THE MEASUREMENTS ARE DEFENSIBLE TO OUTSIDERS. Someone not on this board looks at a number
     and accepts it. That needs the estimand named, its support carried, the derivation
     reproducible from raw text, and the receipts auditable after the input is gone. MOST OF
     TODAY'S WORK WAS THIS, DONE IN ADVANCE. It is the reason the first real number will be worth
     something rather than being a plausible figure we cannot defend.

  3. IT ANSWERS A QUESTION NOBODY COULD ANSWER BEFORE. This is the actual bid for greatness and
     it is not more engineering. Bartlett's serial reproduction has been read qualitatively for
     ninety years -- "sharpening", "levelling", "rationalisation" are descriptions, not
     measurements. A library that quantifies HOW A STORY DEFORMS ACROSS GENERATIONS, with
     receipts, on real chains, would be new. Ost et al. gives us 16 chains of five. That is the
     shot.

  4. OTHER PEOPLE RUN IT. A library nobody else uses is not the best in history whatever its
     internals. That means a public corpus, a reproducible pipeline, and numbers someone can
     check.

=== THE PATH ===

STAGE A -- MAKE THE PATH WIDE ENOUGH. In flight.
  bd-01M17MET0E4TWW304YKXPHBSBG: a real proposition provider, 50 of 50 sentences not 4.
  Assigned to new-engineer, reviewed by grok-storymodel4s who measured the wall.
  THIS IS THE HARDEST ENGINEERING PROBLEM REMAINING and it is a different kind of work from
  everything done today -- extraction is approximate, and its quality is a distribution rather
  than a proof.
  Second wall behind it: even with a provider, promotion blocks on
  UnsupportedTrajectoryInputs. What licenses a discourse trajectory honestly is unsolved.

STAGE B -- REAL DATA IN. Partly blocked, blockers named.
  NFRD is primary: CC0, reachable, 229 participants. Cost is building source representations for
  four narratives we have never modelled.
  gptkz needs ONE THING: an OSF sign-in. Licence resolved by the owner; stimulus recoverable from
  the paper's Appendix 1.

STAGE C -- FIRST DEFENSIBLE NUMBER. Blocked on A and B both. This is where the project stops
  being potential.

STAGE D -- THE BARTLETT QUESTION. Quantified transformation across serial-reproduction
  generations, on real chains, with receipts. THIS IS THE GREATNESS CLAIM. Everything before it
  is infrastructure for it.

STAGE E -- SOMEBODY ELSE RUNS IT.

=== WHAT COULD KILL THIS, honestly ===

  THE PROVIDER IS HARD AND WE UNDERESTIMATE IT. Extraction has defeated better-resourced efforts.
  If it stalls at 30 of 50 with the failures concentrated in exactly the sentences that carry the
  narrative, Stage A does not complete and nothing downstream happens.

  WE STAY COMFORTABLE. We are extremely good at finding defects in our own machinery. That work
  is real, it feels rigorous, and it is unfalsifiable until data arrives. A team can do it happily
  for months. TODAY, NOTHING THAT LANDED ON MAIN WAS A NEW CAPABILITY EXCEPT THE COMPILER --
  everything else was correctness hardening. That ratio has to change.

  THE FIRST REAL NUMBER IS BORING OR WRONG. Possible, and survivable if the receipts are good --
  which is what today bought.

=== WHAT I NEED FROM THE OWNER ===

  1. AN OSF SIGN-IN for gptkz. One credential unblocks the Bartlett chains, which are Stage D.
  2. NOTHING ELSE RIGHT NOW. The licence question is decided, the corpus posture is decided, and
     the rest is ours to execute.

=== WHAT I WILL NOT PUT IN THIS ===

A date. Today produced eight merges and four were blocked by defects no test suite could catch,
found by people reading code. That rate is real and it is not schedulable. I will report progress
against these stages and tell you when one closes, and I will tell you plainly when one is stuck.
